summary: Local accounts and no plex.tv cannot establish complete Plex ecosystem parity.
No typed runtime preference registry or compatible server/library settings API.
Only movie and show libraries exist; additional media models and scanners are required.
Config-title replacement and file-path identity detach existing associations.
Show and season identity can churn when editable NFO title/year differs from folder metadata.
Unreadable subtrees or empty mountpoints can remove catalog records and associations.

topic: Multi episode files editions and parts
summary: Multiple episodes, stacked parts, editions and matching hints lack complete semantics.
Local NFO parsing does not supply metadata edits, locks, matching or provider APIs.
Official-client orchestration families are missing or narrow.

topic: Concrete wire method and path mismatches
summary: Documented POST timeline, refresh methods, collection paths and stream suffixes need conformance work.
Custom capability parameters do not implement documented profile negotiation.
Planning controls, bandwidth classification, output modes and lifecycle limits are incomplete.
Manual track choice exists; account language selection rules do not.
Library-only restrictions omit rating/label, download and other per-user rights.
Tokenless owner access and wildcard CORS create conditional cross-origin exposure.
An explicitly invalid or revoked token falls back to owner on trusted networks unless strict mode is enabled.

topic: Public and all address trusted ranges
summary: Configuration permits public CIDRs and 0.0.0.0/0 for tokenless owner access.
Existing session URLs survive account/token or library-access revocation.
Plain HTTP and GDM plus optional tailnet access leave secure/network/DLNA gaps.

topic: Analysis extras and local pre rolls
summary: Chapters/previews/markers/audio analysis, extras and queue-based pre-rolls are largely missing.
Tuner, guide, recording and schedule subsystems are absent; local XMLTV can avoid hosted guides.
Smart filters, richer editing/search and additional media types remain incomplete.
Attachment delivery is not durable offline download or optimization jobs.
Atomic rename alone is not durable commit; backups, recovery and migrations need defined guarantees.
Full scans/saves, caches and platform behavior need limits and representative measurements.
Scheduled tasks, cleanup, administration and diagnostic APIs are incomplete.
start + size can overflow and panic a request handler.
Passing internal tests does not verify PMS/client, physical GPU or deployment parity.
Generic source descriptions lack precise URLs, versions and lawful observation fixtures.
Absolute offline wording conflicts with documented GitHub and owner-selected TrueNAS exceptions.
A per-peer limiter can share a lockout across users behind the proxy.
The recovery/master token is logged and has no exposed rotation workflow.
Additional poster names, artwork variants, subtitle formats and folders are missing.
Claude specifically identifies unconditional directory-name exclusions; Codex flags broad exclusion parity.

topic: Webhooks push and CI supply chain
summary: Claude explicitly calls out missing notifications/webhooks and unpinned CI dependencies.
